definitions.gloss: to build up, to construct over time, to establish
definitions.explanation: To create something substantial through sustained effort over time. Often used for abstract accomplishments like careers, reputations, relationships, or fortunes, as well as physical structures.

examples.japanese: ⟦{信頼|しんらい}{関係|かんけい}→信頼関係：16095_shinraikankei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{築|きず}き{上|あ}げる。
examples.english: To build up a relationship of trust.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一代|いちだい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{財産|ざいさん}→財産：01635_zaisan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{築|きず}き{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: He built up his fortune in a single generation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧{築|きず}き{上|あ}げてきた⟦{実績|じっせき}→実績：04214_jisseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つながって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The track record built up over many years has led to today's success.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Ichidan compound verb: ⟦{築|きず}く→築く：02046_kizuku⟧ (to build) + ⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (to raise up). The ⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ component adds the nuance of completion and accumulated effort.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{築|きず}き{上|あ}げる: to build up trust
- ⟦{財産|ざいさん}→財産：01635_zaisan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{築|きず}き{上|あ}げる: to amass a fortune
- ⟦{地位|ちい}→地位：03427_chii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{築|きず}き{上|あ}げる: to establish a position
- ⟦{実績|じっせき}→実績：04214_jisseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{築|きず}き{上|あ}げる: to build up a track record
- ⟦{文明|ぶんめい}→文明：03611_bunmei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{築|きず}き{上|あ}げる: to build a civilization

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{築|きず}く→築く：02046_kizuku⟧ on its own also means "to build" but is more neutral. {築|きず}き{上|あ}げる emphasizes the cumulative, effortful process of building something significant from nothing.
